mainMenu.label: Main menu
mainMenu.playHint: Race, time trial, battle, Rocket Gol

modeSelect.title: Game mode
modeSelect.subtitle: Pick how you want to race.

race.name: Race
race.description: Three laps, one podium. First across the line wins.

timeTrial.name: Time Trial
timeTrial.description: Just you and the clock: beat your best time.

battle.name: Battle
battle.description: Closed arena, items in hand: last kart standing wins.

rocketGol.name: Rocket Gol
rocketGol.description: Kart football: two teams, one giant ball.

playType.title: Match type
playType.subtitle: On this device or over a network?

local.name: Local
local.description: On this device, split screen, keyboard and gamepads.

online.name: Network
online.description: Online with your friends, or on several machines on the same network (Wi-Fi, cable): installed app and browser together.

local.title: Local players
local.subtitle: Each player presses START on their controller to join.
local.continueHint: A ready player presses START to continue.
local.waitingHint: Waiting for at least one ready player.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.codePending: Assigned once connected to the server
lobby.charactersPending: All players must confirm their character.
lobby.duplicateCharacters: Two players confirmed the same character.
lobby.vehiclesPending: All players must confirm their vehicle.
lobby.trackPending: The track hasn't been chosen yet.

language.hint: Changes apply instantly and are remembered.

controls.raceHint: Used as soon as the karts can drive (phase 2).
controls.stickNote: The left stick always steers, in menus and in races.
controls.intro: Click a slot, then press the key you want.
controls.waitingKey: Press a key for "{{action}}" (Esc to cancel).
controls.waitingButton: Press a gamepad button for "{{action}}" (Esc to cancel).

notices.swapped: {{key}} was used for "{{other}}": the keys were swapped.
notices.reserved: {{key}} is reserved (Esc, F, Tab, function keys).
notices.required: "{{action}}" must keep at least one key.

race.speedClassHint: Kart speed and computer driver skill. On LAN, the host's choice applies.

tank.name: Tank
tank.strength: Shoves light karts aside, shrugs off hits

standard.name: Standard
standard.strength: Balanced and easy to pick up

special.name: Special
special.weakness: Low grip, very fragile in collisions

selection.allConfirmed: Everyone is ready: press START to continue.

trackSelect.title: Tracks
trackSelect.cupDescription: All {{count}} tracks in a row, with points for every race: the best total wins the cup.
trackSelect.subtitleTracks: {{player}} builds the schedule: one track, several, or the whole cup.
trackSelect.pendingCups: Pick a cup to see its tracks.
trackSelect.pendingTracks: A: add or remove a track. BACK: other cups. START: continue.
trackSelect.playlistCount: {{count}} race(s) out of {{max}} at most, in this order.
trackSelect.playlistWholeCup: No track picked: the whole {{cup}} will be raced ({{count}} races).
trackSelect.pointsRule: Every race awards points, added up until you go back to the menu.

kairosMeadow.name: Kairos Meadow
kairosMeadow.description: A flowing loop through meadows and a pond, perfect to get started.

mirrorLake.name: Mirror Lake
mirrorLake.description: A wide loop around the lake, with a tight chicane by the water.

echoWoods.name: Echo Woods
echoWoods.description: S-bends and hairpins deep in a pine forest.

turquoiseCoast.name: Turquoise Coast
turquoiseCoast.description: Along the sea, then an S-hairpin before the line: the longest of the cup.

sunsetCanyon.name: Sunset Canyon
sunsetCanyon.description: Climb between ochre cliffs, then race back down towards the oasis.

alpinePass.name: Alpine Pass
alpinePass.description: Twenty metres of climbing to the pass, then a long descent through the pines.

cloudRidge.name: Cloud Ridge
cloudRidge.description: A string of bumps above the lake: take them fast and the kart goes light.

duneRun.name: Dune Run
duneRun.description: Rolling dunes and wide corners: keep your speed through the bumps.

frostHollow.name: Frost Hollow
frostHollow.description: A snowy hollow around a frozen lake, then a tight chicane between the drifts.

borealPass.name: Boreal Pass
borealPass.description: Climb to the white peaks, wind back down, then glide over the icy water.

icefallRun.name: Icefall Run
icefallRun.description: A huge frozen lake in the middle; right after the start, a glide over a bay.

whitePines.name: White Pines
whitePines.description: A snowy pine forest, hairpins and walls where the road folds back.

rustMesa.name: Rust Mesa
rustMesa.description: Red dirt plateaus, dry climbs and two ramps to fly over the track.

clayQuarry.name: Clay Quarry
clayQuarry.description: A quarry carved in hairpins around a pond, the clay sticks to the wheels.

dustWhirl.name: Dust Whirl
dustWhirl.description: A long track that coils in on itself like a sand whirlwind.

rutRally.name: Rut Rally
rutRally.description: Ruts, bumps and linked corners around a muddy pond.

vote.title: Next track
vote.subtitle: Each player votes for a track; the most picked one is raced (tie: random draw).

pause.title: Pause
pause.changeHint: The current race is abandoned, with no points.
pause.hint: Up / down · A: select · BACK: go back · START: resume

lan.title: Network play
lan.subtitle: Online, or with the other machines on the same network: installed app or browser.
lan.howTo: Online: Play online, create a room and give its code to your friends. Local network: the host runs the installed Kart Able app (or the smkw-api server); the others open the address shown by the host in their browser, or type it below.

server.title: Other server
server.help: Empty: the server that opened this page. Otherwise a local network host (192.168.1.20:2567) or an online server (kart-able.fly.dev).

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.empty: No open room: create yours, or ask the host for the code.

lobby.waitingOthers: Waiting for the players on the other machines.
lobby.hostCanStart: The whole room is ready: start the game.
lobby.invite: Other players on the network open http://{{address}} then join room {{code}}.
lobby.inviteOnline: Your friends open Kart Able (website or app), go to Network play, Play online, then join room {{code}}.

internet.title: Online
internet.help: Play with your friends wherever they are: create a room, then give them its code.
internet.missing: No online server is configured for this version: type the address of a Kart Able server in Other server.
